_doc: Regions for 'run_testretest_analysis.py collect --regions-json', for sessions that have
a tumour ROI (rater SG, written into the derived SG run by
run_testretest_derive_rater.py; pass that run as --regions-root so the ROI applies to
every rater's fits). The '_nontumor' regions are the DCEPrep tissue masks with the
tumour ROI removed. Which region carries the claim is a pre-registration decision; this
file only makes them available. A session without a tumour ROI gets WM and GM only.
